summary: Comprehensive testing of IPTV Bell Canada clone. All 26 backend API tests pass (after fixing UserCreate model). All 27 frontend test scenarios verified including login, 6-tab dashboard, CRUD for channels/programs/devices/users, settings, forgot password, TV guide home route, and logout. One security issue found: users list accessible without authentication.

critical.issue: Users list returns ALL user data without any authentication token required. Any unauthenticated client can retrieve full user list including emails and account details.

issues: Channel logo images fail to load (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED for placeholder URLs). The fallback placeholder URL 'https://via.placeholder.com' fails in the preview environment - not critical but shows broken image icons.

action_items: Add authentication requirement to GET /api/users endpoint (add Depends(get_current_admin) or similar auth check)
The placeholder fallback URL 'https://via.placeholder.com' is not accessible from the preview environment - consider using a local SVG fallback or a data URI for channel logos
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY: GET /api/users has no authentication check - any user can list all users without logging in. UserManagementTab sends auth header but the backend doesn't enforce it.

BUG FIXED: UserCreate model was missing notes, account_status, max_devices fields - when creating a user with these fields from the frontend, they were silently ignored. Fixed by adding them to UserCreate model.
CODE QUALITY: The devices GET/PUT/DELETE endpoints have no authentication guards either (same as users). Anyone can list, create, or modify devices without auth.
NOTE: The /api/setup/service-config POST endpoint has no auth requirement which could allow unauthenticated service name changes.
seed_data_creation: Created and left test data: test channels (TEST_Channel_*), testuser99, test_user_dc50445e from backend tests. These were mostly cleaned up by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. The only remaining concern is the missing auth on GET /api/users and GET /api/devices endpoints (they work unauthenticated). The UserCreate model fix was applied to /app/backend/models/user.py (added notes, account_status, max_devices fields). The TV Guide at / shows correctly with EPG grid, channels list, and service name from DB.

UserCreate missing fields.root_cause: UserCreate model in /app/backend/models/user.py only extended UserBase (username, email, full_name) + password. Fields notes, account_status, and max_devices were only on the User model, not UserCreate.
UserCreate missing fields.reproduction: POST /api/users with notes field - notes will be None in DB response despite being sent
UserCreate missing fields.mitigation: Added notes, account_status, max_devices to UserCreate model class

Users API no auth.root_cause: GET /api/users in routes/users.py has no Depends(get_current_admin) dependency - no auth check at all
Users API no auth.reproduction: curl https://bell-tv-clone-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/users returns full user list without any Authorization header
Users API no auth.mitigation: Add auth dependency: async def get_users(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_db), admin: Admin = Depends(get_current_admin))
